items.html:
(to the question) The surrounding ones of the LM of the Tzelem
The level of the ten Sefirot of the Mochin that comes out in the upper one for the need of the lower one is divided into inner and surrounding ones, where the inner ones are called the Tzadi of the Tzelem, meaning the VAK of those Mochin, and the surrounding ones are called the LM of the Tzelem, meaning the GAR of those ten Sefirot. (Part 1, Page 158, Item 98).
